decisions.reason: The supplement range has had several years on established pharmacy channels and costs little to carry, but with no website evidence since 2019 its value is only partly revealed, so the option stays open with moderate risk of pruning.

The skin and hair supplement fits the consumer health strategy and is cheap to keep, but the firm already dropped similar niche supplements and B has not been visible since 2019, so withdrawal is a real possibility even though holding it remains reasonable.

The OTC triptan is an approved product in a growing self-medication segment, which gives it significant remaining upside and justifies keeping the option even though it lies outside the core offer and has no archived evidence since 2019.
